title: zl.nth
description: get an element of a list, counting from 1

messages.description: performs the operation again on the last received list
list to take the element from
index, optionally followed by a replacement element
the other elements, with the replacement in its place if one is set

arguments.description: index of the element, counting from 1
replacement for the element in the right outlet's list (optional)

methods.description: clears the mode's arguments and the data received in both inlets
sets the maximum list size, 1 to 32767

body: [zl.nth] outputs the element at an index, counting from 1, through the left outlet, and the remaining elements through the right outlet. If a replacement is set, it takes the element's place in the right outlet's list. With an index of 0 (the default) or out of range, all elements go to the right outlet. [zl.mth] counts from 0 instead.
